content.short: OnRe, a Bermuda-regulated reinsurer, brings reinsurance returns onchain through ONyc, a yield-bearing token on Solana.
content.description: OnRe is regulated in Bermuda and underwrites reinsurance with brokers Guy Carpenter and Howden. ONyc represents a share of a segregated reinsurance account, so its yield comes from underwriting premiums and investment of the collateral, not from crypto markets. Holders can simply collect the yield, borrow against ONyc on Kamino or swap it on Orca. It gives DeFi users a return that does not move with token prices. ONyc can be minted through open or institutional access, holders earn OnRe points, and the protocol publishes a transparency dashboard and independent attestations.
